answer: Anti-Sybil via beacon-timed whisper challenges: each identity keeps a public challenge beacon that must answer encrypted whisper nonces at secret offsets. Auditors walk a spiral of rising hop distance and drop late or duplicate-host replies. Only a warm process holding that key can MAC the nonce in time, so extra identities need separate always-on beacons—one shared bot cannot cover staggered offsets. Limitation: rented fleets still scale, but cost grows per clone and idle clones miss their window.
